name: FinTech News Impact Benchmark v1
task: Predict the direction and impact strength of a financial technology news item for a target asset.
disclosure: 6551 News Research both maintains this benchmark and submits the in-house newsliquid-1.0-flash leaderboard entry.

label_schema.impact_score: integer 0-100; event strength for the target asset, not realized future return
label_schema.label: [L|S|N][0-100]

scoring.latency: single-news end-to-end latency; no batching or cache reuse

data_file_note: Use data/test_public.jsonl for inference and evaluation. data/benchmark_with_reference.jsonl includes reference labels and is for audit/analysis only.
annotation_note: Reference labels are human-annotated benchmark test-set labels packaged for scoring.
source_normalization_note: source and news_type preserve raw feed values and casing; source_counts_top20 is not case-normalized.
provenance_public_note: Public files intentionally avoid internal model/provider names.
